positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Maintained, administered, and updated the primary webpage using HTML, CSS, and PHP
- Developed and implemented design based on staff and visitors’ feedback
- Created graphics and layout design using Adobe Photoshop CS5 and Lightroom 3
- Maintained NO15's databases and email servers

company.name: UC San Diego - Instructional Web Development Center

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
- Developed secure and accessible dynamic websites in PHP and ASP.net
- Wrote automatic scripts for different functions in PHP
- Maintained databases and servers for different sections and departments 
- Audited existing websites for security exploits and took steps to resolve or mitigate the vulnerabilities
- Audited the IWDC network for security exploits and recommended actions to eliminate or mitigate the vulnerabilities
- Reviewed system logs
- Provided technical support for all Instructional Web Development services, including the LMS, podcasting, and Blackboard
- Oversaw all of UCSD clubs' blogs and websites on the UCSD server

positions.title: Lead Technician
positions.description:
•	Assisted students and faculty daily on technical computing issues including network administration, audio-visual troubleshooting, multi-department coordination, and student computing resources
•	Removed viruses and malware from infected computers in addition to educating users on computer security
•	Informed users and managed the database in regards to DMCA Copyright Violations for policies of the university
•	Trained, supervised, and administered performance evaluations for Residential Computer Consultants (RCCs)
•	Oversaw the training of new staff, conducted phone interviews, and designed training modules while conducting training workshops
•	Provided excellent customer service for people with diverse technological backgrounds

volunteerExperiences.description: The Rescue House is a non-profit, all volunteer-based organization dedicated to assisting cats through its rescue, foster and adoption activities. We find loving homes for unwanted, abandoned, homeless, and abused cats. We open our arms to socialized, people-friendly cats that need assistance, regardless of age and handicap. We find good homes for every cat that we take in – we are a true no-kill cat rescue organization.  We provide foster care for our rescued cats until they are ready to enter an adoption center. I visit our adoption centers and take care of the cats by cleaning their enclosures, socialize them with humans, make them get used to being around humans, and talk to potential cat adopters to make sure if their living situation will be ideal for a particular cat.
